findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_cancellation_policies" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "sse" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_cancellation_policies, create_reservation_request · Public sink: search_available_restaurants, create_reservation, create_reservation_request · Destructive: get_cancellation_policies, create_reservation_request.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_cancellation_policies, create_reservation_request · Public sink: search_available_restaurants, create_reservation, create_reservation_request · Destructive: get_cancellation_policies, create_reservation_request

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
